description_en: Queries the information about a custom alert rule
description_zh: 调用GetRemind接口，获取自定义监控报警规则的详情
name: GetRemind

Data.description_en: The details of the custom alert rule
Data.description_zh: 自定义监控规则的详情

AlertInterval.description_en: The minimum interval at which alerts are reported. Unit: seconds
AlertInterval.description_zh: 最小报警间隔，单位为秒

items.description_en:
The notification method. Valid values:

MAIL
SMS
Alert notifications can be sent by text message only in the Singapore, Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur), and Germany (Frankfurt) regions
items.description_zh:
报警的方式，取值如下：
MAIL（邮件）
SMS（短信）
<props="intl">可使用短信告警的地域为：新加坡、马来西亚（吉隆坡）、德国（法兰克福）。</props><props="china">PHONE（电话，仅DataWorks专业版及以上版本支持）。</props>

AlertTargets.description_en: The description of the alert recipient. For more information about alert recipients, see the Receivers parameter
AlertTargets.description_zh: 报警接收人说明。多类型告警接收人参考出参Receivers

items.description_en:
If the value of the AlertUnit parameter is OWNER, this parameter is left empty.
If the value of the AlertUnit parameter is OTHER, the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the specified user is returned.
If the value of the AlertUnit parameter is SHIFT_SCHEDULE, the shift schedule ID is returned
items.description_zh:
当AlertUnit（报警接收人）为OWNER（节点任务责任人）时，返回空。
当AlertUnit（报警接收人）为OTHER（指定的人）时，返回指定用户的阿里云UID。
当AlertUnit（报警接收人）为SHIFT_SCHEDULE（值班表）时，返回值班表ID

AlertUnit.description_en:
The type of the alert recipient. For more information about alert recipient types, see the Receivers parameter. Valid values:

OWNER: the task owner
OTHER: specified personnel
SHIFT_SCHEDULE: personnel in a shift schedule
AlertUnit.description_zh:
报警接收对象类型，多类型告警接收人参考出参Receivers。
OWNER（任务责任人）
OTHER（指定的人）
SHIFT_SCHEDULE（值班表）

AllowNodes.description_en: The IDs of the nodes that are added to a whitelist

items.description_en: The ID of the node that is added to a whitelist. The nodes that you add to the whitelist are not monitored
items.description_zh: 白名单中的任务ID，在监控时会被忽略

Baselines.description_en: The baselines to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is BASELINE
Baselines.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为BASELINE（基线）时，该规则监控的基线列表

BizProcesses.description_en: The workflows to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is BIZPROCESS
BizProcesses.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为BIZPROCESS（业务流程）时，该规则监控的业务流程列表

Detail.description_en:
If the value of the RemindType parameter is FINISHED, this parameter is left empty.
If the value of the RemindType parameter is UNFINISHED, the trigger conditions are returned as key-value pairs. Example: {"hour":23,"minu":59}. Valid values of hour: [0,47]. Valid values of minu: [0,59].
If the value of the RemindType parameter is ERROR, this parameter is left empty.
If the value of the RemindType parameter is CYCLE_UNFINISHED, the trigger conditions are returned as key-value pairs. Example: {"1":"05:50","2":"06:50","3":"07:50","4":"08:50","5":"09:50","6":"10:50","7":"11:50","8":"12:50","9":"13:50","10":"14:50","11":"15:50","12":"16:50","13":"17:50","14":"18:50","15":"19:50","16":"20:50","17":"21:50","18":"22:50","19":"23:50","20":"24:50","21":"25:50"}. The key indicates the ID of the cycle. Valid values: [1,288]. The value indicates the timeout period of the node that is running in the cycle. Specify the value in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,47]. Valid values of mm: [0,59].
If the value of the RemindType parameter is TIMEOUT, the timeout period is returned. Unit: seconds. Example: 1800. This value indicates that an alert is reported if the node has run for more than 30 minutes
Detail.description_zh:
当RemindType（触发条件）为FINISHED（完成）时，返回空。

当RemindType（触发条件）为UNFINISHED（未完成）时，返回格式为{"hour":23,"minu":59}。hour的取值范围为[0,47]，minu的取值范围为[0,59]。

当RemindType（触发条件）为ERROR（出错）时，返回空。

当RemindType（触发条件）为CYCLE_UNFINISHED（周期未完成）时，返回格式为{"1":"05:50","2":"06:50","3":"07:50","4":"08:50","5":"09:50","6":"10:50","7":"11:50","8":"12:50","9":"13:50","10":"14:50","11":"15:50","12":"16:50","13":"17:50","14":"18:50","15":"19:50","16":"20:50","17":"21:50","18":"22:50","19":"23:50","20":"24:50","21":"25:50"}。JSON字符串key为周期号，取值范围为[1,288]。value为该周期对应的未完成时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]。

当RemindType（触发条件）为TIMEOUT（运行超时）时，返回格式为1800，单位为秒。即从开始运行起，运行超过30分钟触发报警

DndEnd.description_en: The end time of the quiet hours. The value is in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,23]. Valid values of mm: [0,59]
DndEnd.description_zh: 免打扰截止时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,23]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]

DndStart.description_en: The start time of the quiet hours. The value is in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,23]. Valid values of mm: [0,59]
DndStart.description_zh: 免打扰起始时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,23]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]

Founder.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the creator of the custom alert rule
Founder.description_zh: 自定义监控规则创建人的阿里云UID

Nodes.description_en: The nodes to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is NODE
Nodes.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为NODE（任务节点）时，该规则监控的节点列表

Owner.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the node owner

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the node belongs

Projects.description_en: The workspaces to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is PROJECT
Projects.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为PROJECT（工作空间）时，该规则监控的工作空间列表

Receivers.description_en: The information about the alert recipients

If the value of the AlertUnit parameter is OTHER, the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the specified user is returned.

items.description_zh:

当AlertUnit（报警接收人）为OTHER（指定的人）时，返回指定用户的阿里云UID。
当AlertUnit（报警接收人）为SHIFT_SCHEDULE（值班表）时，返回值班表ID

AlertUnit.description_en:

AlertUnit.description_zh:

RemindType.description_en: The conditions that trigger an alert. Valid values: FINISHED, UNFINISHED, ERROR, CYCLE_UNFINISHED, and TIMEOUT
RemindType.description_zh: 触发条件，包括FINISHED（完成）、UNFINISHED（未完成）、ERROR（出错）、CYCLE_UNFINISHED（周期未完成）和TIMEOUT（运行超时）

RemindUnit.description_en: The type of the object to which the custom alert rule is applied. Valid values: NODE, BASELINE, PROJECT, and BIZPROCESS. The value NODE indicates a node. The value BASELINE indicates a baseline. The value PROJECT indicates a workspace. The value BIZPROCESS indicates a workflow
RemindUnit.description_zh: 对象的类型，包括NODE（任务节点）、BASELINE（基线）、PROJECT（工作空间）和BIZPROCESS（业务流程）

Robots.description_en: The webhook URLs of the DingTalk chatbots
Robots.description_zh: 钉钉群机器人的webhook地址列表

AtAll.description_en: Indicates whether all group members are notified when the alert notification is sent to a DingTalk group. Valid values: true and false
AtAll.description_zh: 是否@所有人，包括true（是）和false（否）

WebUrl.description_en: The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot

Useflag.description_en: Indicates whether the custom alert rule is enabled. Valid values: true and false
Useflag.description_zh: 自定义监控规则是否开启，包括true（开启）和false（关闭）

items.description_en: The webhook URL of the WeCom or Lark chatbot. You must specify Webhooks for AlertMethods. Only DataWorks Enterprise Edition supports this parameter
items.description_zh:
企业微信或飞书机器人的WebHook地址。AlertMethods中需要包含WebHook告警方式。
自定义Webhook仅DataWorks企业版支持

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
